designDecisions: MODAL COLLAPSE AT DISPATCH FOR NAMED PRESETS (Max accepted 2026-07-11). In-band bodies (Rocky/Ocean/Eyeball — BAND mass/T/V window, e1Regime.js inSeededBand) dispatch on the exported seed-free modalRegime(V,T), NOT the live seeded pick. Reason: the seeded pick lands 'stagnant' on some seeds → effectiveL → 'mixed' → the 75-golden (captured 7441c92, NEVER re-capture) breaks and shipped preset worlds change per-seed. The seeded multistability stays FULLY ALIVE in the computeE1 tuple, the _lab.e1Probe, and the _lab.e1RegimeWeights override (the 2b-2b pilot worlds are unaffected); it goes production-live with SEEDED bodies at V2-10 game-port. This mirrors exactly how the V2-1 oracle proved writer-equality (its writerE1 collapses via modalRegime).

FROZEN GOLDEN CARVE-OUT = ASSERT-EQUAL-DESPUN, NEVER RE-CAPTURE (Max accepted 2026-07-11). Frozen(airless)'s 5 golden rows WILL change (the adjudicated shell→despun reroute). Mechanism: the byte-identity harness keeps the captured goldens for the other 70 rows bit-identical AND asserts Frozen's post-flip output equals the DESPUN writer's output (writeGrainSphere+writeHeightSphere at the same seeds) computed fresh — an adjudicated-divergence assertion, not a re-capture. 70/75 untouched goldens stay the zero-clobber burden-carriers.

EYEBALL: TODAY WINS via DISPATCH-LEVEL locked-awareness (oracle EXPECTED_DIVERGENCES disposition; V2-1 BUILD-PLAN §4.5 disposition-direction note). E1 stays locked-BLIND (must-fix #4b preserved — computeE1 gains NO locked input); the DISPATCH layer reads locked (as writeBodyRelief already does today) and routes a locked temperate rocky to the eyeball-despun shell writer BYTE-IDENTICAL. E1's 'plate' answer for Eyeball is NOT adopted.

MARS: MAPPING + ORACLE ROW, RENDER UNCHANGED. Mars joins the oracle (17/17) and gains its archetype-map entry, but its derived route is dead-lid → despun — the SAME writer it reaches today via archetype null. Zero visible change. The dead-lid family's real look is V2-5 bombardment's job; the Tharsis expression stays reachable in the lab via the 2b-2a hand-set D-vector seam. (§7a 'Mars→stagnant/dead' intention resolves as 'dead' on the real E1 numbers: T210 < COLD_DEAD_T 250, Φ 0.268 < 0.4.)

NEPTUNIAN/SUB-NEPTUNE = TAXONOMY-ONLY, ZERO VISIBLE CHANGE (the AMENDED §5.2: writer-EQUAL both ways, NOT a divergence). The short-key collision ('Ice giant (Neptunian)' → 'sub-neptune') is resolved without flipping any drawn or seeded radius — the ROADMAP's radius hazard (demoting Neptunian→'gas-giant' flips seeded radius [2.5,4.0]→[6.0,14.0]) is exactly what must NOT happen. Mechanism (dedicated 'ice-giant' key with today's effective range vs keep-key+document) is a build-plan call under the zero-visible-change constraint; any new archetype key registers in the taxonomy (AC-0 check 3).

PRESET_ARCHETYPE SURVIVES AS FALLBACK ORACLE — NOT DELETED HERE. The map + the four dispatch predicates (isEarthlikePlatePath/isShellReliefPath/isVolcanicPath/isStagnantLidPath) stay in the tree as the cross-check oracle. Retirement trigger (ROADMAP §5.2 point 3): post-V2-3 verify-workstream green + Max UAT → deletion is a separate follow-up commit, only after every enumerated misroute is explicitly resolved.

FENCES (Max confirmed 2026-07-11): no game-port wiring (_pickType untouched, E1 lab-only per charter); no new expression work (writers/composer feature-frozen); no lab-GUI reorganization in-contract (the lab UX pass runs alongside as main-session work, Max-judged, not AC-gated); guardrails unchanged from 2b-2b (no 4th carrier.regime constant, three-free base/ writers, stage only files we touch — the not-ours CameraChoreographer.js/LabMode.js + untracked screenshot pile stay out of every commit).
